messages:
Cassie M: Quick check-in for Cascade launch week SEO runway. We need: final KW map, JSON-LD for landing + 2 posts, internal anchor matrix, redirect precedence CSV, and GTM -> HubSpot routing. Can we lock by EOD tomorrow?

Theo R: I can own redirects + canonical table. Proposed canonical = https://www.redwood.ai/cascade (no trailing slash). Will stage 302s for 48h then flip 301 if metrics look good.

Priya S: I'll do schema & FAQ. Plan: Event on landing, Article + mainEntity for posts, Speaker Person markup, and FAQPage on one post variant for an A/B test.

Cassie M: nice. Also want internal linking to tie product docs -> benchmark post -> landing. Avoid repeating exact-match anchors more than twice.

Theo R: sample redirect CSV (header required):
```
source,target,type,notes
/cascade-old-guide,https://www.redwood.ai/cascade,302,monitor traffic 48h
/cascade-web-2026,https://www.redwood.ai/cascade,302,legacy campaign slug
```

Priya S: JSON-LD draft for landing (tiny, will expand):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"Event","name":"Cascade: Low-latency Inference Webinar","startDate":"2026-07-14T16:00:00Z","url":"https://www.redwood.ai/cascade"},{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Is this webinar live or recorded?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Live with a recording available afterwards."}}]}]}
```

Olivia (seo-bot): Quick flags: 1) duplicate H1 detected between cascade launch post and evergreen guide; tweak the guide H1 to avoid cannibalization. 2) meta descriptions for benchmark and landing overlap 90% - change one to focus on results vs product. 3) add OG image on landing.

Cassie M: acceptance checklist for launch: redirects uploaded to s3 and smoke-tested, canonical tag verified on all variants, JSON-LD present on landing + top post variant, internal anchors applied in copy, sitemap updated and submitted, GTM params validated and webhook to HubSpot tested.

Theo R: infra path: upload CSV to `s3://redwood-deploy/redirects/cascade-q3.csv`. Then run `/deploy redirects cascade-q3`. publishing-bot will post status.

publishing-bot: Reminder: CSV must be UTF-8, header: source,target,type,notes. After deploy run `publishing-bot check-schema <url>` to validate JSON-LD presence.

Priya S: mini A/B: we'll include FAQPage schema on Post-B only. Tag Post-B links with `&variant=B` so we can attribute. Also include `&utm_term=faqtest` in GTM for measurement.

Theo R: canonical rules: landing = /cascade, posts -> add rel=canonical to point to their own canonical (not landing). Legacy campaign URLs should rel=canonical to /cascade only if consolidated content; otherwise keep distinct canonical.

Cassie M: internal anchor suggestions (short list):
- "low-latency inference" -> launch post CTA
- "inference benchmark" -> benchmark narrative
- "production inference best practices" -> evergreen guide
- "watch the webinar" -> landing
Make sure anchor diversity across docs.

Olivia (seo-bot): Sitemap & Search Console play: add new URLs to staging sitemap, run `curl https://staging.redwood.ai/sitemap.xml | grep cascade` to confirm, then submit to Search Console after 302 monitoring window or immediately if urgent crawl needed. Also run Mobile-Friendly and Rich Results test pre/post deploy.

Theo R: I'll upload CSV this afternoon and post the deploy command here. After deploy, run `curl -I <legacy-url>` to confirm redirect headers. If precedence collision in CSV, deploy will fail and list conflicts.

Priya S: speaker snippet (tiny):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Person","name":"Dr. Lina M","jobTitle":"Director of Inference","affiliation":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```

Cassie M: GTM params we agreed: `?utm_source=launch&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=cascade_q3` + append `&variant=A|B` for A/B. HubSpot mapping: campaign -> contact property, variant -> list segmentation. Raj will confirm webhook mapping separately.

Priya S: structured data test step: paste JSON-LD into head, run rich results test, screenshot output, and attach to the tracker. publishing-bot will verify presence too.

Olivia (seo-bot): Also please tweak meta title for benchmark post to "Cascade benchmark results" (avoid 'Cascade' + 'Launch' duplication). Add a small description change to increase uniqueness.

Cassie M: Everyone drop a 1-line status in the tracker by EOD. If any infra blocker, tag eng-infra and @deploy-oncall. We'll reconvene 9:30am tomorrow for post-deploy checks. Thanks! :rocket:
